newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones closes above 6,000 points for first time ever.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones closes above 6,000 points for first time ever.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average closed above the 6,000-point milestone for the first time ever Monday, less than a year after ending above the 5,000-point mark on Nov. 21, 1995.
At the 4. p.m. EDT closing bell, the Dow closed up 41.74 points at 6,011.12.
Last Monday, the index of 30 blue-chip stocks rallied for the first time through 6,000 but failed to close above that level.
